mapper.select: SELECT id, account, password_hash, nickname, avatar_url, status, role, created_at, updated_at FROM sys_user WHERE LOWER(account) = LOWER(#{account}) LIMIT 1
SELECT id, account, password_hash, nickname, avatar_url, status, role, created_at, updated_at FROM sys_user WHERE id = #{id} LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_user (id, account, password_hash, nickname, avatar_url, status, role, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{account}, #{passwordHash}, #{nickname}, #{avatarUrl}, #{status}, #{role}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE sys_user SET password_hash = #{passwordHash}, nickname = #{nickname}, avatar_url = #{avatarUrl}, status = #{status}, role = #{role}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE id = #{id}
